message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live market data, so I can’t give you the exact gold price for today.  

For the most up‑to‑date price you can check one of the following reliable sources:

| Source | Typical URL |
|--------|-------------|
| **Kitco** | https://www.kitco.com/ |
| **Bloomberg** | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets/commodities |
| **Reuters** | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities |
| **London Bullion Market Association (LBMA)** | https://www.lbma.org.uk/ |
| **U.S. Treasury or Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC)** | https://www.cftc.gov/ |

These sites update gold prices in real time (usually within seconds of the market). If you need the price for a specific time or historical data, most of them offer charts and downloadable data as well.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the gold price today in USA?" They want the current gold price. We cannot browse the internet. We can provide approximate or typical price, but we don't have real-time data. We can explain that we can't fetch real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Kitco, etc. We can also provide a typical range. But we should not provide inaccurate data. So we should respond that we cannot provide real-time data.
